videos.title: 2122 - Cockroach or Nice Guy?
videos.overview: Ana, a former Miss Europe, has a crush on Jacobo, a Marbella native with a settled life. Javi is a marathon man, Mitra is also an athlete, and both are looking for something serious. Jymi and her stuffed animal give the eccentric and activist Mario a test to find out if he's a cockroach. And Lorena "gets heated" and goes on the attack with Álvaro, who happily goes along with it.

videos.title: 2123 - The Opportunity Is Bald
videos.overview: Jessica is a golf fanatic, and Sergio is more into tennis, but she's having so much fun she feels like singing. Valeria "La Brillantes" and Cris recognize each other as two "bald transvestites" and have understood each other perfectly from the first minute. Melanie, who has been away from the flirtatious scene for a while, tries to reconnect on "First Dates," although she admits that Juan Manuel "is not her type."

videos.title: 2124 - On a Motorcycle and Going Crazy
videos.overview: Fari is a girl who wants to enjoy her freedom and the freedom to choose who she falls in love with. Her date, Guillermo, is an artist. On the other hand, Jesús is a passionate motorcyclist who enjoys spending time on his bike. He's looking for someone who gives him good vibes and respects his space. Teresa, his date, is a very empathetic person with a great sense of humor.

videos.title: 2125 - Formality, seriousness, and ironing skills
videos.overview: Paz is a man who has always made a living and is currently quite settled. He's looking for a formal, serious person who knows what they want... and who knows how to iron, to live with him. His date is Cristina, who is looking for an independent man who will treat her well. On the other hand, Nashme is passionate about art and is looking to find the perfect person. His date is Ainhoa.

videos.title: 2126 - Open to finding love
videos.overview: Martín is single for the first time in many years and, after a while, has decided to open himself up to love again. His date is Vanina, who is looking for someone to complete her family. On the other hand, Jorge is a very positive and fun-loving man. His date, Asun, is Galician and proud of her roots.

videos.title: 2127 - People Who Shine Inside and Out
videos.overview: Candela opens her heart again after 56 years of marriage, and Ricardo has fallen for her smile. Gabriel comes from London to meet Daniel, who was already with us, albeit with a slightly different face. Belén is worried that she might have gotten into OT if it weren't for Chenoa, and doesn't pay much attention to Joaquín, her date. And Álvaro and Lu connect when they discover that they both like wrestling.

videos.title: 2128 - The Fashion of Love
videos.overview: Mario is a ratista and independent man, looking for a partner who respects his freedom. His date is Pilar, who is self-confident and has many suitors. Kiko, a model and fan of personal care, wants to believe in love again. His date is Rocío, also a model and single mother, with a mature and clear vision of relationships.

videos.title: 2129 - Between Bills and Naturism
videos.overview: José Ángel is looking for a stable relationship with a sincere woman. His date is Andrea, a woman also looking for a serious relationship, hoping for a lifelong one. Pedro, on the other hand, is a naturist man who advocates nudism as a lifestyle. He is looking for a loving and passionate woman to share an open relationship with. His date, Daniela, shares his vision.

videos.title: 2130 - From the Countryside to Love
videos.overview: Nicol is looking for an honest man with traditional values. Her date is José, a down-to-earth country man. Yojan, a lawyer and artist, wants someone authentic and self-confident. His date is Thian, a daring man who leaves no one indifferent.

videos.title: 2131 - We're Going to Berlin, I Don't Want Any Recriminations
videos.overview: Kevin lives in Berlin, but dreams of finding love in Spain, and Sergio seems happy to welcome him. Tomasa returns to 'First Dates' and finds herself greeted by a lavish reception orchestrated by Ernesto, a gentleman passionate about pasodobles but too focused on his phone. And Lola arrives dressed as a cow to meet Alberto, who was a stripper in his youth, although she doesn't like him in clothes.

videos.title: 2132 - Mystical Hearts and God's Will
videos.overview: Jesus is writing about his mystical experiences and is looking for someone intelligent who will bring love and understanding to his life. His date is Rosa, a spiritual woman for whom God is the center of everything. Óscar, on the other hand, is a proactive man, a music lover, looking for a simple girl. Naiara, his date, practices boxing and has a strong and determined character.

videos.title: 2133 - A date isn't always a shock
videos.overview: Vicente repeats and exclaims, "Oh, I'm really into you!" this time with Elloína. Paula has turned her greatest passions—mental health and horses—into a living, but Andrea isn't buying her therapy. Manuel immediately falls in love with Victoria, but her face betrays that the feeling isn't mutual.

videos.title: 2134 - Rebels and in search of love
videos.overview: Adrián is an active and rebellious man looking for a woman with character. His date is María, a clear-minded woman who lives life at a thousand miles an hour. Ángel, on the other hand, is a calm man who wants a dynamic partner. His date is María Jesús. She's looking for someone to build something serious with and isn't interested in open or casual relationships.

videos.title: 2135 - Partnered but Free
videos.overview: Pilar is an outgoing and independent woman looking for an equally free man without jealousy. Her date is Timothy, a youthful man eager to have a good time. Yanira, conceited and self-confident, is looking for a goal-oriented, outgoing, and athletic guy. Her date is Juan, a young man passionate about sports.

videos.title: 2136 - It's About Ghosts
videos.overview: Julia is a tarot reader who has seen ghosts since she was little; Jose, her date, will have to deal with these presences if their relationship is going to go forward. Carlos, on the other hand, will use his guitar to try to get Angry to see through.

videos.title: Episode 2137
videos.overview: Alberto is a very flirtatious guy... even if it doesn't seem like it, after the surprise he got the first time he came to the program. Now he's back, eager to find love with an extroverted girl. His date is Cynthia, a very active and open-minded young woman. Adelina, a spontaneous woman, is looking for a partner to share good times with. Her date is José, an attentive and thoughtful gentleman.

videos.title: Episode 2138
videos.overview: Jesús is 39 years old, an administrator and teacher, and after five years of being single, he comes from Madrid to the love restaurant, eager to meet someone with whom he connects. Víctor, his date, is 26 years old, a student of Spanish Sign Language, and also comes from Madrid looking for someone sincere and who will accept him just the way he is.
